rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: CraftedTrust provides independent security verification and trust scoring for MCP servers and AI agent tools. The service scans servers across 7 security domains using 50+ automated checks, provides CoSAI-aligned trust scores (0-100), and offers certification with cryptographic integrity proofs. Tools include trust score lookup, live security scanning, and registry search across 4,200+ indexed servers.
